📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has declared the preliminary (screening) exam result for GIC Lecturer Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. A-6/E-1/2025), releasing subject-wise provisional merit lists of candidates qualified for the Mains examination. Results have gone out in batches for subjects including Sociology, Geography, Economics, Civics, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, English, History, Biology, Hindi, Urdu, Sanskrit, and Psychology/Criminology & Penology. Candidates can check their status on the official website uppsc.up.nic.in. The Mains online application window is currently active on the same portal.

Direct Link tio Check UPPSC GIC Lecturer Result 2026

Particular Details
Organization Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC)
Post Name Lecturer (Male/Female), Government Inter College (GIC)
Advertisement No. A-6/E-1/2025
Exam Stage Preliminary / Screening Exam Result (Qualified for Mains)
Result Status Declared, subject-wise
Next Stage Mains Written Examination
Official Website uppsc.up.nic.in

UPPSC GIC Lecturer Result 2026: Subjects Declared So Far

UPPSC has released the provisional list of candidates qualified for Mains in the following subject groups, each as a separate PDF on the official website:

  • Sociology & Geography
  • Economics, Civics & Physics
  • Chemistry, Mathematics, English & History
  • Biology, Hindi, Urdu & Sanskrit
  • Psychology, Criminology & Penology

Subject-Wise Qualified Candidates

The following candidate counts are reported by exam news portals covering the first batch of results and could not be independently cross-verified against the original PDF at the time of writing. Candidates are advised to confirm exact numbers from the official merit list PDF.

Subject Candidates Qualified for Mains (as reported)
Sociology 806
Economics 924
Civics 2,323
Physics 1,575
Geography 1,927

Vacancy Details

Total vacancies for GIC Lecturer Recruitment 2026 are reported differently across sources some cite approximately 1,516 posts, others approximately 1,518 posts, across multiple subject streams under Advertisement No. A-6/E-1/2025. This discrepancy has not been resolved against the original notification PDF, so candidates should treat this figure as approximate and confirm the exact, subject-wise vacancy breakup from the official notification on uppsc.up.nic.in.

How to Check UPPSC GIC Lecturer Result 2026

  1. Visit the official UPPSC website: uppsc.up.nic.in
  2. Go to the "Results" section on the homepage, or the Latest News/Notifications panel.
  3. Click on the subject-relevant link: "List of Candidates Provisionally Qualified for Mains in Advt. No. A-6/E-1/2025, Lect. (M./F.) Govt. Inter College Exam-2025" for your subject.
  4. The result PDF will open in a new window.
  5. Use Ctrl+F to search your roll number, or verify using your One Time Registration (OTR) number.
  6. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

What Happens After the Result

Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the subject-wise qualified list are provisionally eligible to appear for the UPPSC GIC Lecturer Mains Written Examination. There is no interview round for this recruitment as per commonly reported information, final selection is based entirely on marks secured in the Mains exam, though candidates should confirm this from the official notification. The Mains online application (Conventional Form) process is currently active on the official portal.

Important Instructions

  • The result declared is provisional. Final selection depends on document verification and the Mains examination.
  • If a mistake is noticed in personal details or the qualifying status, candidates should contact UPPSC through the official grievance/feedback section immediately.
  • Keep your OTR (One Time Registration) number and roll number handy for all future stages.
  • Regularly check the official website, as UPPSC is releasing subject-wise results and Mains-related notices in phases.
  • Do not rely solely on third-party portals for critical dates always cross-check with the official notice PDF on uppsc.up.nic.in.

SECR Bilaspur Apprentice Merit List Details

The 1191 Act Apprentice vacancies were notified on 12 May 2026 across trades under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Against this notification, SECR Bilaspur has now released a provisional list of 520 candidates called for document verification, prepared using the aggregate of Class 10th and ITI percentage marks. This is the first provisional list  the notice itself specifies it is provisional and subject to correction for typographical errors, so candidates should treat their inclusion as tentative until document verification is complete.

Trade-wise Reporting Dates

Trade Reporting Date
COPA 3 August 2026
Electrician 4 August 2026
Fitter 5 August 2026
Carpenter, Draughtsman (Civil), Electronic Mechanic, Machinist, Mechanic (RAC), SMW 6 August 2026
Steno (English), Steno (Hindi), Diesel Mechanic, Turner, Welder, Wireman 7 August 2026

All candidates must report by 10:00 AM on their trade's designated date at the Sr. DPO Office, DRM Complex, Bilaspur (C.G.). Candidates called for document verification represent roughly six times the trade's vacancy count, per the standard SECR provisional-list practice referenced in the notice.

Documents Required for Document Verification

  • Original Medical Fitness Certificate
  • Original Central Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/OBC and other backward class candidates, where applicable)
  • Photocopy of Aadhaar and PAN Card (name and father's name must match the Class 10th certificate)
  • Clear photocopy of Bank Passbook matching Aadhaar details only a centralized bank account is accepted
  • 4 recent passport-size photographs
  • Written self-declaration copy (as specified by the candidate)
  • Original PWD (Persons with Disability) Certificate, if applicable

Missing even one required document will lead to the candidature being treated as cancelled, so candidates should carry complete documentation and not rely on any document being waived.

Also Read: BPSC District Sports Officer Marks 2026

Important Instructions

  • This merit list is entirely provisional and based on the information candidates entered in their online application. SECR retains the right to modify or cancel any name found to contain a typographical or factual error.
  • Selected candidates should be mentally prepared to sign a 1-year contract agreement at the time of joining.
  • Candidates must bring their own luggage and arrange their own accommodation near the reporting venue.
  • Training is expected to begin within a day or two of certificate verification, so candidates should be prepared to stay on rather than plan a same-day return.

The Reserve Bank of India Services Board (RBISB) has declared the RBI Officer Grade 'B' (DR) – DEPR Cadre Phase-I Result 2026 on June 30, 2026, for the Panel Year 2026 recruitment cycle. Candidates who cleared Phase-I are now shortlisted to appear for the Phase-II examination, scheduled for July 26, 2026. This article covers everything you need to know from checking your roll number to downloading your Phase-II admit card.

Click Here: RBI Grade B (DEPR) Result 2026

RBI Grade B DEPR Result 2026 - Quick Overview

This section summarizes the core details of the result announcement so you can quickly confirm what has been released and what stage you're at in the recruitment process.

The result pertains to Officers in Grade 'B' (DR) – DEPR Cadre, published under Advt. No. RBISB/DA/01/2026-27 dated April 29, 2026. It marks the completion of Phase-I and the start of the Phase-II selection stage.

Detail Information
Conducting Body Reserve Bank of India Services Board (RBISB)
Post Officer Grade 'B' (DR) – DEPR Cadre
Advertisement No. RBISB/DA/01/2026-27 (dated 29 April 2026)
Total DEPR Vacancies 10 posts
Phase-I Exam Date (DEPR) 14 June 2026
Phase-I Result Declared 30 June 2026
Phase-II Exam Date (DEPR) 26 July 2026
Number of Shifts (Phase-II) 2 (Shift 1 and Shift 2)
Admit Card Single admit card for both shifts
Official Website rbi.org.in

How to Check Your RBI Grade B DEPR Phase-I Result

This section explains the exact process for confirming your roll number in the official result document, so you know where to look and what to avoid.

The result has been published as a roll-number list within an official PDF on the RBI website. Rather than depending on third-party lists, always verify your own status directly.

  • Visit the official RBI website: www.rbi.org.in, or the Opportunities@RBI recruitment portal.
  • Open the official Phase-I DEPR Result PDF for the roll number list.
  • Use Ctrl+F (or Cmd+F) on the PDF and search for your own roll number.
  • Save or download the PDF for your future reference.

RBI has also noted a standard disclaimer with this result: despite careful preparation, the Board reserves the right to correct any inadvertent errors. If you spot a discrepancy in your details, wait for an official corrigendum rather than relying on unverified sources.

RBI Grade B DEPR Eligibility Criteria

This section outlines the qualification requirement specific to the DEPR cadre, useful for candidates confirming they meet the criteria before Phase-II.

Candidates applying for the DEPR cadre must possess a Master's Degree in Economics, or a Master's Degree in Finance/PGDM/MBA from a recognized university or institution.

RBI Grade B DEPR Phase-II Exam 2026: Key Details

This section explains what to expect in the Phase-II stage, including the exam date, shift structure, and admit card rules points candidates often get confused about.

Phase-II for the DEPR cadre is scheduled for July 26, 2026, and will be conducted in two shifts on the same day. A few important points to note:

  • One exam, two shifts: Candidates must appear for all papers across both shifts attending only one shift is not allowed.
  • Single admit card: RBI will issue only one admit card covering both shifts, unlike exams that issue separate call letters per shift.
  • No logistical flexibility: No request for change of exam date, shift, centre, or venue will be entertained under any circumstance. Plan your travel and stay in advance once your centre is confirmed.

How to Download the RBI Grade B Phase-II Admit Card

This section provides the step-by-step process to download your Phase-II admit card once RBI activates the link.

  1. Visit the official RBI website: www.rbi.org.in.
  2. Locate the Phase-II admit card link under the careers/recruitment section.
  3. Log in using your registration number and password/date of birth.
  4. Download the admit card and verify your exam date, shift timing, and venue carefully.
  5. Along with the admit card, RBI will also release an Information Handout for Phase-II, plus separate instructions for PwBD candidates using a scribe or compensatory time, and for candidates with specified disability (less than 40%) who have difficulty writing.

RBI Grade B Selection Process

This section explains the overall stages of selection for the Officer Grade B recruitment, as outlined in the official notification.

According to the official recruitment details, the selection process comprises:

  • Online Examination (CBT) Phase-I and Phase-II
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT)
  • Final Merit List

This article covers everything you need to know about the SBI CBO Result 2026, including the direct download link, step-by-step checking process, vacancy breakup, selection process, and the interview schedule.

SBI CBO Result 2026 Direct Download Link

This section gives you quick access to the official SBI CBO Result PDF so you don't have to navigate through multiple pages on the SBI website.

The list of candidates qualified for the interview has been uploaded as a PDF on the SBI careers page. You can access the result PDF directly here:

SBI CBO Result 2026 PDF - Direct Download Link

The PDF lists roll numbers/registration numbers of candidates shortlisted for the interview, along with the advertisement number and post details.

How to Check SBI CBO Result 2026 (Step-by-Step)

If the direct link isn't working due to heavy traffic, candidates can also check the result by navigating the official SBI careers website manually using the steps below.

  1. Visit the official SBI careers portal at sbi.bank.in.
  2. Click on the "Current Openings" section on the homepage.
  3. Look for the link titled "Recruitment of Circle Based Officer (List of Candidates Qualified for Interview Announced)".
  4. Click on "List of Candidates Qualified for Interview".
  5. The result PDF will open download and save it.
  6. Use Ctrl + F to search your roll number or registration number quickly within the PDF.

SBI CBO Result 2026: What Does the PDF Contain?

Candidates should know exactly what information appears in the result document before they search for their names, so they can verify their status correctly.

The SBI CBO Result 2026 PDF includes:

  • Recruiting authority's name and advertisement number
  • Post name (Circle Based Officer)
  • Roll numbers/registration numbers of candidates shortlisted for interview
  • Instructions regarding the next stage of recruitment

There is no separate merit list at this stage the PDF is a qualifying list for the interview round, not a final selection list.

SBI CBO 2026 Total Vacancies

Knowing the total number of vacancies helps candidates understand how competitive the shortlisting for interview has been.

The official SBI notification and the state-wise vacancy breakup add up to 2,050 posts. It's worth noting for accuracy that a few report portals have listed the vacancy figure as 2,273; candidates are advised to cross-check the exact number against the official CBO notification PDF on sbi.co.in, since this is the only authoritative source for the final vacancy count.

SBI CBO Selection Process 2026: What Happens After the Result?

Candidates naturally want to know what comes next after clearing the online exam this section outlines the complete selection journey.

Shortlisted candidates will now move through the remaining stages of the SBI CBO recruitment process:

  • Interview
  • Language Proficiency Test
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination
  • Final Selection

The final merit list is prepared based on combined performance in the online examination and interview, with a reported weightage split of 75:25 (online test : interview), and the interview itself carries 50 marks.

SBI CBO Interview 2026: Date and Details

Since the interview is the immediate next step for shortlisted candidates, here's what is currently known about its schedule.

Reports indicate the SBI CBO interview round is scheduled for mid-July 2026, with different sources citing dates of 13 July and 14 July 2026. As this detail is subject to confirmation, candidates should wait for the official interview call letter on the SBI careers portal for their exact date, time, and venue rather than relying on any single unconfirmed date.

How Is the SBI CBO Merit Calculated?

Understanding the marking scheme helps candidates interpret their own performance realistically before the scorecard is released.

The SBI CBO written exam follows a standard negative marking pattern:

Final Marks = (Correct Answers × 1) - (Wrong Answers × 0.25)

Answer Type Marking Rule
Correct Answer +1 mark
Wrong Answer -0.25 mark
Unattempted Question No penalty

A separate scorecard showing section-wise and overall marks is typically released by SBI after the result, accessible through candidate login credentials on the careers portal.

The MPESB AEO/RAEO exam, originally scheduled for 2 August 2026, has been revised by the board to 5 August 2026. MP RAEO Admit Card 2026 - Download link

The direct link to download the MP RAEO Admit Card 2026 will be activated by the Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) on its official website after the admit card is released. Candidates appearing for the Rural Agriculture Extension Officer (RAEO) / Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) Group 2 Sub Group 1 Recruitment Exam 2026 can access their hall ticket using their application number and date of birth.

As per MPESB’s usual release pattern, the MP RAEO Admit Card 2026 is expected to be released around 3 to 5 days before the exam date. Since the revised exam date is 5 August 2026, the admit card is likely to be available from 1 August 2026 to 2 August 2026 (expected). However, the exact release date will be confirmed only through the official MPESB notification.

When Will the MP RAEO Admit Card 2026 Be Released?

MPESB has not officially announced the admit card release date for this exam. Going by MPESB's usual pattern for other Group 2 exams (such as MP PNST and MPESB Hospital Assistant, where hall tickets were released in the days immediately before the test), admit cards are generally issued 3 to 4 days before the exam date. Based on this pattern and the revised exam date of 5 August 2026, the RAEO admit card can reasonably be expected around 1-2 August 2026  but this is an estimate based on past trends, not a confirmed MPESB date. Candidates should keep checking esb.mp.gov.in directly for the official release.

How to Download MP RAEO Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official MPESB website: esb.mp.gov.in.
  2. Go to the "Admit Card" section on the homepage, once activated for the Group 2 Sub-Group 1 (RAEO/AEO) exam.
  3. Log in using your application/registration number and date of birth (the credentials used at the time of application).
  4. Your MP RAEO Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen check all details carefully.
  5. Download the admit card and take a clear printout in color or black and white.
  6. Keep at least one extra printed copy along with a valid photo ID for exam day.

Details Mentioned on the MP RAEO Admit Card

Based on the format MPESB follows for its other Group 2 exams, the admit card is expected to carry the following details. Candidates should verify all fields the moment their own admit card is released.

  • Candidate's name, photograph, and signature
  • Application/roll number
  • Exam date, shift, and reporting time
  • Exam centre name and address
  • Category and post applied for
  • General exam-day instructions

Documents to Carry on MP RAEO Exam Day

  • Printed MP RAEO Admit Card 2026
  • A valid original photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence, or PAN Card)
  • Aadhaar card is required to be unlocked/active for biometric verification at the exam centre, as noted by MPESB for this recruitment cycle
  • Passport-size photograph, if specified on the admit card once released

MP RAEO Exam Day: Important Instructions

Exact shift timings for the revised 5 August 2026 exam date have not been officially confirmed. For the earlier-announced 2 August 2026 schedule, MPESB listed the following shift structure, which candidates can use as a general reference until their individual admit card confirms the final timing:

Shift Reporting Time Exam Time
Shift 1 7:00 AM - 8:00 AM 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM (3 hours)
Shift 2 12:30 PM - 1:30 PM 2:30 PM - 5:30 PM (3 hours)
  • Reach the exam centre well before the reporting time; late entry is generally not permitted.
  • A 10-minute instruction-reading period is typically given before the test begins.
  • Electronic gadgets, smartwatches, calculators, and study material are not allowed inside the exam hall.
  • Carry both your admit card and original photo ID entry can be refused without either.
  • Report any discrepancy in your admit card (name, photo, exam centre, category) to MPESB immediately through the official helpline, rather than waiting until exam day.

PSPCL JE Normalization Formula 2026

As per clause 5.2 of advertisement CRA 316/26, since the exam is conducted across multiple shifts with different question papers, PSPCL applies a normalization formula to ensure fairness across shifts.

  • Base Shift Selection: The shift with the highest average raw score is used as the base for normalization. If that shift has fewer than 70% of the average attendance, the shift with the next-highest average is used instead.
  • Normalized Score Formula: Xn = (S2/S1) × (X - Xav) + Yav, where:
    • S2 = Standard Deviation of the base shift (highest average score)
    • S1 = Standard Deviation of the candidate's shift
    • X = Raw score of the candidate
    • Xav = Average score of the candidate's shift
    • Yav = Average score of the base shift
  • Score Calculation Before Normalization: Candidate Score (H) = Total Correct Responses (D) - Negative Marks Allotted (G). Normalized Score (C) = (H/B) × 100, where B is the number of valid questions.

SBI CBO 2026 Selection Process Explained

Understanding how your final selection is calculated helps you prepare strategically for the interview. This section explains the complete selection methodology for SBI CBO 2026.

The SBI Circle Based Officer recruitment follows a multi-stage selection process:

  3. Interview - Worth 50 marks, assessing banking awareness, professional knowledge, and communication skills.
  4. Local Language Proficiency Test - Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the regional/local language relevant to their applied state or circle.

How Is the Final Merit List Prepared?

The final selection isn't based on the interview alone it combines scores from multiple stages using a fixed weightage formula.

The final merit list for SBI CBO 2026 is prepared using combined weightage:

  • Online Examination: 75% weightage
  • Interview: 25% weightage

This means strong performance in the online exam significantly boosts your overall chances, but a good interview score remains essential for the final cutoff.

CBI Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit, and nationality conditions set by the Central Bank of India to be eligible for the Apprentice post.

Educational Qualification

  • A graduation degree (bachelor's degree) in any discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Candidates should have completed graduation on or after 1 January 2022 (some sources indicate the cut-off as 1 January 2021; candidates should verify the exact date on the official notification).
  • Candidates with one year or more of work or training experience after graduation are not eligible, since this scheme is meant for fresh graduates.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training elsewhere, are not eligible.
  • Basic computer knowledge is required.
  • Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the state they are applying for.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Salary / Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. This is a training stipend rather than a regular salary, and no other allowances or benefits are provided. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment with the bank.

Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

How to Download RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026

Downloading the RBI Grade B call letter is a straightforward process. The same steps apply for both Phase 1 (already released) and Phase 2 (upcoming). Follow the steps below to access your hall ticket from the official website.

Documents to Carry to the RBI Grade B Exam Centre

Carrying the right documents to the examination centre is mandatory. Entry will not be granted if the candidate fails to produce valid identity proof along with the printed admit card.

RBI Grade B Exam Pattern 2026

Understanding the exam pattern helps candidates prepare effectively for both phases of the selection process. The RBI Grade B selection consists of Phase 1 (Prelims), Phase 2 (Mains), and an Interview round.

Phase 1 Exam Pattern - Objective Type (Qualifying)

Phase 1 is a 2-hour online objective exam carrying 200 marks across 200 questions. Since it is only qualifying, candidates must clear it to advance to Mains, but these marks do not count toward the final score.

Candidates must reach the exam centre before the gate closing time without fail. Biometric verification including thumb impression and photograph capture will be conducted at the centre. Ensure your name on the admit card matches exactly with your photo ID. Wearing clothes with metal items, large buttons, or accessories that could trigger security checks should be avoided. Electronic devices including mobile phones, smart watches, Bluetooth devices, calculators, and books are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall. The exam centre and date allotted on the call letter are final no requests for change of centre, date, or session will be entertained.

Eligibility Criteria for CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026

Candidates planning to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Bharti 2026 must meet all eligibility conditions set by CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd. The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and no upper age limit is mentioned in the official notification. Candidates must hold a valid Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate from a UIDAI-authorized testing and certifying agency.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must have one of the following qualifications to be eligible for the CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026:

Qualification Option Details
Option 1 12th Pass (Intermediate / Senior Secondary)
Option 2 Matriculation + 2 Years ITI
Option 3 Matriculation + 3 Years Polytechnic Diploma

Age Limit

The minimum age to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator Vacancy 2026 is 18 years. No maximum age or age relaxation details are mentioned in the official notification.

Mandatory Certificate Requirement

Every applicant must possess an Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a Testing & Certifying Agency authorized by UIDAI for delivering Aadhaar services. Additionally, candidates must have basic computer skills. Candidates who do not yet hold this certificate can appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam through the link: https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action

Who is NOT Eligible

As per the official notification, VLEs (Village Level Entrepreneurs) are not eligible to apply for the Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator - District post under this CSC recruitment drive.

Salary / Remuneration - CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator 2026

Selected candidates under the CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026 will be paid as per the state government's prescribed wage structure. The remuneration for all selected Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator candidates will be the minimum wages of the respective state set for semi-skilled manpower. The exact figure will vary from state to state based on the applicable minimum wage notification of Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, or Maharashtra.

How to Obtain the Aadhaar Supervisor Certificate Before Applying

Candidates who do not yet hold the mandatory Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate need to complete two steps before they are eligible to apply for CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra jobs. First, they must apply for and pass the Aadhaar Supervisor exam; second, they must complete the LMS certification. Both processes are managed through official UIDAI platforms.

  1. Visit the Aadhaar Supervisor exam portal at https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action and submit your exam application.
  2. An authorization request will be sent to the State Team. Once approved, you will be permitted to appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam.
  3. After your LMS ID and Password are created and approved, appear for the Aadhaar LMS Certification through the portal at https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in
  4. Once certified, proceed to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor district post on the CSC Job Portal.

How to Apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026

The CSC Aadhaar Operator Apply Online 2026 process is conducted entirely through the official CSC Job Portal at career.csccloud.in. Candidates must ensure they have their Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate ready before beginning the application. The last date to apply is 20 August 2026, and no offline applications are accepted under this recruitment.

  1. Visit the official CSC Job Portal at career.csccloud.in.
  2. Navigate to the relevant job post for your state - Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, or Maharashtra.
  3. Click on the "Apply Now" button on the job post page.
  4. Fill in the online application form with your personal, educational, and certification details.
  5. Upload the required documents including your Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate.
  6. Submit the application form before 20 August 2026.

CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Apply Online 2026

Eligible candidates can submit their online applications for the CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026 through the official CSC Job Portal. The apply online facility is available for all four states - Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra. Ensure your Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate is valid and issued by a UIDAI-authorized agency before clicking Apply Now. The online application window closes on 20 August 2026.

Common Mistakes to Avoid in CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026

Many candidates make avoidable errors while applying for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Vacancy 2026 that can lead to rejection of their application. The points below are based on common patterns seen in similar contractual government recruitment drives and are not derived from the official notification.

  1. Applying without a valid UIDAI certificate: The Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate from a UIDAI-authorized agency is a mandatory requirement. Applying without it will result in disqualification.
  2. VLEs applying despite ineligibility: VLEs are explicitly barred from applying. Submitting an application as a VLE wastes your time and will be rejected at the verification stage.
  3. Applying for the wrong district: Each vacancy is district-specific. Ensure you apply for the correct district as per your location and preference.
  4. Incomplete LMS Certification: Candidates sometimes have the Supervisor exam cleared but not the LMS Certification. Both are required before applying.
  5. Submitting incorrect documents: Upload clear, legible scans of your educational certificates and Aadhaar Operator certificate. Blurry or mismatched documents can cause rejection.
  6. Missing the last date: The portal closes applications on 20 August 2026. Do not wait until the last day — technical issues near the deadline are common.
  7. Confusing CSC e-Governance with state government jobs: This is a contractual, not permanent government post. Ensure you understand the terms of engagement before applying.

AVNL Recruitment 2026: Exam Pattern

The written exam is a single Computer Based Test (CBT), objective multiple-choice type, for a maximum of 100 marks, with no negative marking.

Part Subject Questions Marks
Part A (General Paper) General Awareness 10 10
Part A (General Paper) General English 10 10
Part A (General Paper) Quantitative Aptitude 10 10
Part A (General Paper) Reasoning Ability 10 10
Part A (General Paper) Computer Aptitude 10 10
Part A Total   50 50
Part B (Junior Technician) NCVT syllabus of relevant trade 50 50
Part B (Junior/Assistant/Deputy Manager) Relevant discipline 50 50

Part A questions are up to 10th Standard level for Junior Technician posts, and Graduate level for all other posts. Total time allowed for the written exam is 2 hours. Written exam weightage is 100% for Junior Technician posts and 85% for Junior Manager, Assistant Manager, and Deputy Manager posts. There is no written exam (CBT) for Senior Manager, Deputy General Manager, Additional General Manager, and Consultant posts.

AVNL Recruitment 2026: Selection Process

  • Junior Technician posts: CBT, followed by a qualifying Trade Test (Practical) at the respective AVNL unit. Merit is decided solely on Written Test marks; the Trade Test syllabus is per Annexure-A of the official notification.
  • Junior Manager, Assistant Manager, Deputy Manager posts: CBT, followed by an Interview (50 marks, 15% weightage) assessing technical knowledge, prior work experience, initiative, and decision-making. Merit is decided on combined Written Exam and Interview performance.
  • Senior Manager, Deputy General Manager, Additional General Manager, Consultant posts: No written CBT. Candidates are assessed through Presentation, Experience, Expertise, Knowledge, and Interview, conducted at AVNL CO, Avadi.
  • Candidates qualifying the CBT will be called for Interview (other than Junior Technicians) or Trade Test (Junior Technicians) in a post:candidate ratio of 1:3 in order of merit within each category; the final ratio will be decided by AVNL management based on the number of qualifying candidates.
  • Names of candidates shortlisted for CBT, Interview, or Trade Test, and final selections, will be notified on the AVNL website.

AVNL Recruitment 2026: Test Centres

The CBT will be held at: Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Jabalpur, Nagpur, Pune, Mumbai, New Delhi, Kolkata, and Kanpur. Candidates must indicate their preferred test centre in the online application form. AVNL reserves the right to modify, add, or cancel test centres depending on the number of eligible applicants; affected candidates will be assigned a new centre.

  • Class X passing certificate/marksheet, PAN Card, and Aadhaar Card for name and date-of-birth proof (name and DOB must match across all documents)
  • Caste/disability certificate (for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS candidates), as applicable
  • Trade Apprentice Training Certificate (for Ex-Trade Apprentices of AVNL)
  • OBC-NCL certificate in central format for the current financial year (FY 2026-27)
  • EWS candidates: current-year Income & Asset certificate (valid for FY 2026-27, based on FY 2025-26 income)
  • Disability certificate as per the latest prescribed central government format, generated via the Swavalamban/UDID portal, clearly indicating type and percentage of disability

Qualification Documents

  • NTC/NAC certificate in the relevant trade issued by NCVT (for Junior Technician posts)
  • Bachelor's Degree (Provisional/Final) Certificate (for all other posts)

How to Apply for AVNL Recruitment 2026

Step 1: Registration

  1. Visit the AVNL website and click the "Careers" tab at avnl.co.in
  2. Go to Career - "Register"
  3. Fill in Post name, Post Code (auto-selected), Name, Mobile Number, and Email ID
  4. Generate OTP, enter Captcha, and submit
  5. Enter the OTP received
  6. Accept Terms & Conditions via the "I Agree" checkbox, then click re-verify
  7. Select the checkboxes confirming entered values are correct, enter Captcha for re-verification, and submit registration details
  8. Receive the Registration Number, Login ID, and Password on the registered Email/Mobile

Step 2: Filling the Application Form & Fee Payment

  1. Click "Go to Application" or log in again with the Login ID and Password
  2. Fill in the complete application form
  3. Upload photograph, signature, and required documents (DOB proof, Proof of Educational Qualification, Category Certificate, Apprenticeship Training Certificate, PwBD/Ex-Servicemen proof, if applicable)
  4. Preview the application form before submission
  5. Edit details if required (Name, Post Applied, Email ID, and Mobile Number cannot be changed once submitted)
  6. Submit the application by clicking "I Agree" and entering the Captcha

Step 3: Fee Payment

  1. Choose the payment mode and proceed to the Payment Gateway
  2. Do not refresh or navigate back during payment
  3. Verify fee details and pay the application fee online
  4. On successful payment confirmation, you will be redirected back to the submitted application form
  5. Download the Application/Registration form for your records

No document is required to be sent to AVNL by post; the downloaded application slip should be retained by the candidate for future reference.

Important Instructions

  • Selection of Option for ALL Units wherever a post is available is mandatory to complete the application.
  • Candidates should necessarily upload all required documents while applying; applications with incomplete or insufficient documents are liable to be rejected.
  • Candidates are advised to apply for one post; in case of a clash in CBT dates, the candidate must choose one post/trade to appear for.
  • The category once filled in the online application form cannot be changed.
  • All computation of age, experience, and qualification requirements will be done with reference to the closing date of online registration.
  • Where a qualifying degree does not mention the required specialization, candidates must submit a certificate from their University/Institution at the time of Interview/Trade Test clearly stating their specialization.
  • Assistive devices/scribes for PwD candidates are allowed at the exam centre, subject to prior permission obtained by emailing [email protected].
  • Any dispute arising from this recruitment can be instituted only in Chennai; courts/tribunals/forums at Chennai have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • AVNL reserves the right to cancel, restrict, curtail, or enlarge the number of vacancies at any time without notice.
  • Selected candidates are subject to verification of educational/technical qualifications, category/disability certificate, experience certificate, and character & antecedents, and must be declared "Medically Fit" by a competent authority.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.
  • For any issues related to online application submission or fee payment, contact the Help Desk (via the Help Desk tab on the application portal) at 022-61087565, Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM.

SJVN Limited, a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, has officially released Advertisement No. 127/2026 inviting online applications for 21 posts of Chief General Manager, Deputy Manager, and Engineer across Electrical, Mechanical, C&I, and Chemical disciplines for its wholly owned subsidiary STPL, executing the 1320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project, Bihar. SJVN Limited Recruitment 2026 - Quick Overview

SJVN Limited, a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, has invited online applications through Advertisement No. 127/2026 for 21 posts of Chief General Manager, Deputy Manager and Engineer across Electrical, Mechanical, C&I and Chemical disciplines. These posts are for SJVN's fully owned subsidiary STPL, which is executing the 1320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online at the official SJVN website, www.sjvn.nic.in, from 05/08/2026 up to 26/08/2026.

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

SJVN Experience Requirements

All posts require relevant post-qualification executive experience in Erection/Commissioning and/or Operation & Maintenance (O&M) of Coal-based Thermal Power Plants, including specific experience in Super Critical Thermal Power Plants of minimum 660 MW capacity.

Additional criteria for candidates from Private Sector:

  • CTC should not be less than Rs. 27 Lakhs per annum for E8(a) posts, and not less than Rs. 13.62 Lakhs per annum for E4/E2 posts.
  • Candidate should be working in a reputed organization having a minimum annual turnover of Rs. 2,500 Crore or more (average of the three audited financial years preceding the current year).

Teaching experience, internship, apprenticeship, and pre-qualification experience will not be counted towards the required experience. Periods of sabbatical leave and extraordinary leave will also not be counted.

In addition to Basic Pay and IDA, selected candidates will be entitled to attractive perquisites and benefits, including:

  • Allowances @ 35% of Basic Pay under the Cafeteria Approach
  • HRA / Company-leased accommodation
  • Contributory Provident Fund
  • Conveyance Reimbursement
  • Leave Encashment
  • Performance Related Pay
  • Medical Facility
  • Gratuity
  • Contributory Pension

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

  • Application fee: Rs. 500 plus GST @ 18% (non-refundable), to be paid online.
  • SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/EWS candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee.
  • The application process is treated as complete only after submission of the application fee (where applicable).
  • Application fee is non-refundable even if the candidature is rejected for any reason.

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

  1. Scrutiny of applications based on the job specifications.
  2. SJVN Management reserves the right to conduct a screening test to restrict the number of candidates called for the Personal Interview, if required.
  3. If conducted, the screening test is qualifying in nature only (50% qualifying marks for UR/EWS/ESM and 40% for other reserved categories) and carries no weightage in the final merit list.
  4. Document verification of shortlisted candidates.
  5. Personal Interview - final selection and merit list are based purely on marks secured in the interview.
  6. Qualifying marks in the interview: 50% for UR/EWS/ESM and 40% for SC/ST/PwBD/OBC (NCL).
  7. Candidates have the option to appear for the Personal Interview in Hindi or English.
  8. Experienced candidates with experience beyond the prescribed minimum may be considered for service weightage by the Selection Committee.

Candidates who qualify in the Personal Interview will be adjudged suitable for empanelment, and the offer of appointment will be issued in order of category-wise merit, subject to requirement and medical fitness.

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Documents Required

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (white background, max 50 KB, .jpg format)
  • Signature in blue/black ink (max 50 KB, .jpg format)
  • Educational qualification certificates
  • Experience certificates clearly indicating nature of experience, along with supporting documents such as appointment letter, offer letter, joining order, confirmation letter/order, promotion order, role assignment order, transfer order, service certificate, relieving letter, and pay slips
  • Certified pay and PF slips for the last 6 months
  • Certificate from the employer confirming relevant experience and pay scale/emoluments
  • For private sector candidates: Form 16 and ITR for the last 2 financial years, last pay certificate, CTC certificate on company letterhead, and average audited annual turnover details for 3 financial years
  • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/ESM), as applicable, at the time of the Personal Interview
  • OBC (NCL) certificate in the prescribed format, issued in FY 2026-27 or within the last 6 months
  • Valid photo ID proof (original; photocopies not accepted) at the time of interview

How to Apply for SJVN Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official SJVN website: www.sjvn.nic.in
  2. Go to the Career section and register with a valid, active email ID and mobile number.
  3. Fill in all details in the online application form carefully, including qualification and experience details for each organization worked at.
  4. Upload the required photograph and signature as per the specified format and size.
  5. Pay the applicable application fee online (if not exempted).
  6. Submit the online application before the closing date, i.e., 26/08/2026 (11:59 PM).
  7. Take a printout of the submitted application (preview) and send it along with the payment receipt, experience details and supporting certificates to the address below, so as to reach on or before 15/09/2026:

Postal Address:
Advt. No. 127/2026
O/o DGM (HR/Recruitment)
SJVN Limited, Shakti Sadan, Corporate Head Quarters,
Shanan, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh - 171006

Applications submitted online can be edited/updated until the last date of online submission; no changes are permitted after that date. Applications received in hard copy after the prescribed last date will be summarily rejected.

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Important Instructions

  • Candidates should apply online only; no other mode of submission is accepted.
  • Only one application per post is allowed.
  • Incomplete applications or applications without the requisite application fee will be rejected.
  • Where posts are not reserved for a category, reserved-category candidates may also apply under the UR category if they meet the unreserved eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates called for the Personal Interview will be reimbursed 2nd Class AC Sleeper Rail/Bus fare by the shortest route, as per SJVN rules.
  • Persons working under Central/State Government or Public Sector Undertakings must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Candidates are advised to be cautious of fraudulent persons, agencies, or websites; SJVN does not seek any payment other than the application fee.
  • All correspondence regarding the recruitment will be through the registered e-mail ID only.
  • Any revision, clarification, addendum or corrigendum will be hosted only on the Career section of the SJVN website - no separate notification will be issued.
  • Internal applicants have no upper age bar, and internal candidates with AMIE qualification in the respective discipline are also eligible.
  • For queries, candidates may e-mail [email protected], mentioning "Advt. No. 127/2026 and Designation" in the subject line.

Candidates who obtained their qualification through distance learning or part-time mode are not eligible to apply.

RailTel Apprentice Experience Condition

Any engineering graduate or diploma holder who has undergone, or possesses, training or job/work experience of one year or more after attaining the qualification mentioned above is not eligible. Candidates who completed their graduation or diploma more than three years ago will also not be considered for this apprenticeship. Candidates who have already completed an apprenticeship, terminated one midway, or are currently pursuing an apprenticeship with another organization are not eligible either.

RailTel Apprentice Age Limit

Category Age Limit
General 18 to 27 years, as on the date of notification (28.07.2026)
SC/ST/OBC Age relaxation as per Presidential/Governmental Directives - specific number of relaxation years not specified in the notification

RailTel Apprentice Salary (Stipend)

Selected candidates will receive a monthly consolidated stipend for the one-year apprenticeship period, shared between RailTel and the Government of India (DBT share), as shown below. No other benefit, facility, or allowance is payable apart from this consolidated stipend.

Category Monthly Stipend (₹) RailTel Share (₹) Government/DBT Share (₹)
Graduate Apprentice 14,000 9,500 4,500
Diploma Apprentice 12,000 8,000 4,000

RailTel Apprentice Selection Process

Selection for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following process as described in the notification:

  • A merit list will be prepared region/state/location-wise on receipt of online applications, with preference given to Government Institution pass-outs.
  • Shortlisting will be done based on the merit list prepared using marks obtained in the required qualification (minimum eligibility), and/or through an interview as required.
  • Only candidates found medically fit as per RailTel's norms will be considered for engagement.
  • Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not assure engagement.
  • Candidature is provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates/testimonials at any stage; false or incorrect information can lead to cancellation of candidature or engagement.

Documents Required for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  • Certificate showing CGPA or percentage, to be uploaded in the "Upload Certificate" column on the NATS portal.
  • If only CGPA is mentioned on the certificate, candidates must also upload the CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula/certificate.
  • The Undertaking (Annexure I, provided with the notification), duly filled and signed.
  • The above documents must be uploaded together as a single PDF file of size less than 1 MB.

How to Apply for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026

RailTel Apprentice Apply Online

Eligible candidates must apply online through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) 2.0 portal - no other mode of application will be entertained under any circumstances.

  1. Visit the NATS 2.0 portal at https://nats.education.gov.in.
  2. Candidates not already registered on the NATS 2.0 portal must register themselves before applying for this position.
  3. Follow the application process as described in the NATS Apprentice student manual, available at the portal.
  4. Fill in the application form and upload the certificate showing CGPA or percentage, along with the CGPA-conversion certificate (if applicable) and the signed Undertaking, as a single PDF under 1 MB.
  5. Submit the application on or before the last date, 27.08.2026.

RailTel Apprentice Important Instructions

  • The numbers and locations of posts shown in the notification are indicative and may change without further notice.
  • Apprentice engagement will be strictly for a period of one year, at locations across the Northern, Western, Eastern and Southern regions, or anywhere on a pan-India basis.
  • The reservation policy as prescribed in the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 will be followed; in case of non-availability of candidates in reserved categories, the position will be filled from other reserved or general categories.
  • Apprentices have no right to claim regular employment from RailTel at any point; the apprenticeship does not create any liability on RailTel for providing a job or placement.
  • The decision of RailTel's management will be final and binding on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, and the selection process; no correspondence will be entertained in this regard.

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 29 July 2026 on the official website of Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL). A total of 120 vacancies have been announced through the HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026, including 60 Design Trainee (DT) and 60 Management Trainee (MT) posts across various engineering disciplines.

Candidates aged up to 28 years who have a full-time Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in the relevant discipline with the prescribed minimum marks are eligible to apply for these trainee vacancies. Candidates can download the HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

  • Upper age limit: candidates should not be above 28 years as on 14-08-2026 for UR & EWS category.
  • Candidates belonging to OBC-NCL/SC/ST/EWS categories applying under UR Category will be treated on par with UR criteria.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs), over and above relaxation admissible for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) categories.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years for candidates domiciled in Jammu & Kashmir during 01-01-1980 to 31-12-1989.
  • Upper age limit relaxable up to a maximum of 5 years for Ex-Servicemen/Commissioned Officers/Emergency Commissioned Officers/Short Service Commissioned Officers with at least 5 years of Military Service, subject to other prescribed conditions.
  • Age after all applicable relaxations should not exceed 56 years for PwBDs and 55 years for other candidates.

Also Read: NICL Assistant Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 500 Vacancies

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Reservation of Vacancies

  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS categories will be as per prevalent Government directives.
  • OBC candidates belonging to Creamy Layer are not entitled to relaxation under OBC(NCL) category and must indicate their category as UR in the online application.
  • The candidate's caste/community name must appear in the Central List of Other Backward Classes; a Central OBC(NCL) Certificate not older than 6 months as on 14-08-2026 must be furnished at the time of Interview, if called for.
  • Reservation of vacancies for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) will be distributed among all categories (SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS & UR). PwBDs with not less than 40% of the identified disability shall be eligible for the benefit of reservation.
  • 3 vacancies are earmarked for PwBDs under Design Trainee (all disciplines), and 2 vacancies under Management Trainee (across Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, Metallurgy, Production, and Civil disciplines), covering identified disability categories including Hearing Impairment, Locomotor Disability, Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild), Specific Learning Disability, and Multiple Disabilities, as detailed in the official notification.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • Application fee: ₹500 (inclusive of GST)
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD/Internal candidates are exempted from payment of application fee.
  • Application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.
  • HAL will not be responsible if a candidate deposits the fee to the wrong account or makes multiple payments.
  • Mode of payment: Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI through the SBIePAY payment gateway (for UR/OBC(NCL)/EWS categories only). Applicable convenience fee and taxes, if any, over and above the application fee will be borne by the candidate.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Selection comprises an Online Computer Based Selection Test (All-India basis) followed by a Personal Interview at Bengaluru.
  • The test will be of 2.5 hours duration, comprising Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) in three parts: Part I - 20 MCQs on General Awareness; Part II - 40 MCQs on English & Reasoning; Part III - 100 MCQs on the concerned discipline.
  • The test can be taken in Hindi or English, as per the candidate's choice indicated at the time of applying (cannot be changed later).
  • Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on Online Test marks, in the ratio of 1:5 to the number of vacancies in each discipline and category.
  • The Final Merit List will be prepared with a weightage of 85% for the Online Test and 15% for the Interview.
  • Candidates must secure at least 50% marks each in the Written Test and Interview to qualify for selection (relaxation for reserved categories as per rules).
  • Candidates must produce an original Identity Card (Voter ID/Driving License/Aadhaar/Passport/PAN/Government or PSU-issued ID/College ID) before the Invigilator to appear for the Online Test.

How to Apply for HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  1. Before registering, candidates should have ready: a valid, active e-mail ID; a soft copy passport-size colour photograph (.jpg, under 180 KB); Aadhaar Number and Mobile Number; educational details (semester-wise marks); and employment details (if applicable).
  2. Visit the HAL website www.hal-india.co.in (Careers Section) and click on the link "SELECTION OF DESIGN TRAINEE/MANAGEMENT TRAINEE - 2026," then select the post applied for.
  3. Enter and re-enter a valid e-mail ID for OTP-based registration.
  4. Fill up Eligibility Details and upload the photograph. A unique Application Number will be generated (Eligibility Details cannot be edited once submitted).
  5. Fill up Personal & Qualification Details, with an "Edit" option provided before final submission.
  6. SC/ST/PwBD/Internal candidates: registration is completed upon submission, and an Application Confirmation page is generated.
  7. UR/OBC(NCL)/EWS candidates: will be directed to the Payment Gateway to pay the application fee of ₹500 (inclusive of GST) via Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.
  8. After successful payment, candidates will be redirected to the Application Confirmation Page - print and retain this for future reference.
  9. Complete the process well before the last date (14-08-2026, 1400 hrs) to avoid last-minute website traffic issues. Non-payment of fee or incomplete steps will render the application incomplete and it will be rejected.
  10. Note: Applying for more than one post (e.g., MT Mechanical and DT Mechanical) will lead to rejection of candidature, and any application fee paid will be forfeited.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Placement & Emoluments

  • Selected candidates will be posted at any of HAL's Production, Overhaul, or Service Divisions/Research & Design Centres/Offices, based on Company requirements.
  • Training programme duration: 52 weeks, comprising theoretical and On-the-Job training at various locations.
  • During training, Trainees will draw a stipend comprising Basic Pay of ₹50,000, plus Variable Dearness Allowance and Canteen Allowance. Bachelor Accommodation is also admissible during training, as per Company Rules.
  • On successful completion of training, Trainees will be absorbed as Engineers in the Grade-II Scale of Pay of ₹50,000 - ₹1,60,000, with eligibility for Basic Pay, Variable Dearness Allowance, other Perks & Allowances under the Cafeteria system, Company Accommodation/HRA, Performance Related Pay, Medical Facilities, Provident Fund, Gratuity, and other superannuation benefits as per Company Rules.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Service Agreement Bond

  • Selected candidates must execute a Service Agreement Bond to serve HAL for a period of 5 years (excluding the training period).
  • In case of breach of the Service Agreement (during training or after absorption as Engineer), the candidate is liable to reimburse actual training expenses (including recruitment expenses and all remuneration/expenses incurred during training), subject to a maximum of ₹15,00,000 (Rupees Fifteen Lakhs only).

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Pre-Employment Medical Standards

  • Candidates provisionally selected, including PwBDs, must undergo a Pre-employment Medical Examination before joining HAL.
  • Candidates must have sound health and meet the medical standards prescribed by the Company; appointment is subject to a satisfactory medical report. The decision of the Company's Doctor in this regard is final and binding, and no relaxation in health standards will be allowed.
  • For PwBDs, suitability for appointment will be decided based on Reports of the Medical Board attached to the Special Employment Exchanges for Physically Handicapped; their appointment will remain provisional until Disability Certificate verification is completed.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates employed in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Quasi-Government/Autonomous Bodies (including on contract basis) must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of Interview, failing which they will not be permitted to appear and will not be eligible for Travelling Allowance.
  • Category (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS/UR) once filled in the online application cannot be changed later, and no benefit of another category will be admissible subsequently.
  • Candidates under reserved categories must submit Caste/Income & Asset/Disability Certificate in the prescribed Central Government format at the time of Interview (tentatively scheduled during September 2026 at Bengaluru).
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to verification of Caste/Income & Asset/Disability Certificate and Character & Antecedents from concerned authorities.
  • Internal Candidates of HAL must also apply online and refer to the internal Circular dated 29-07-2026 before filling the application.
  • Mere submission of application does not entail any right to appointment or to appear in different stages of the selection process; HAL's decision in this regard shall be final.
  • There will be no separate communication to candidates regarding non-selection at any stage.
  • HAL reserves the right to cancel/restrict/increase/modify/alter the advertisement or recruitment process, and the number of vacancies notified may be increased/decreased/cancelled at the Company's discretion, without assigning reasons.
  • If information furnished by a candidate is found false, incomplete, suppressed, or not in conformity with eligibility criteria, the candidature/appointment will be revoked/terminated at any stage, without reference to the candidate.
  • Induction Training for DTs/MTs is tentatively scheduled to commence end of October 2026 at Bengaluru.
  • Any canvassing or influencing of officials related to the recruitment/selection process will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Bengaluru. In case of any ambiguity in versions other than English, the English version will prevail.
  • For queries not covered in the notification or FAQs, candidates can write to HAL at [email protected].
  • All recruitment/selection related information will be hosted only on the HAL website www.hal-india.co.in; candidates are advised not to rely on any other website, social media platform, or email/message circulation.
  • Any Corrigendum/Addendum will be issued only on the HAL website.

Candidates from Aeronautical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, Metallurgy, Production, and Civil engineering backgrounds can also explore more (#) Engineering Government Jobs and (#) PSU Recruitment 2026 openings. Those interested in Defence sector careers can check (#) Ministry of Defence Jobs and (#) Bengaluru Government Jobs for more opportunities in a similar domain.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

Sarkari Job Find - Filter by Qualification & State

Not every sarkari job requires a degree. Use the qualification and state filters below to sarkari job find openings that actually match your eligibility, instead of scrolling through listings you don't qualify for.

Sarkari Job for 10th Pass / 12th Pass

Several high-volume recruiters - including Railways (Group D), SSC (MTS, GD), and state police departments - recruit primarily at the 10th pass and 12th pass level. Browse these openings on our 10th & 12th Pass Jobs page.

Sarkari Job for Graduates & Postgraduates

Graduate and postgraduate-level sarkari jobs include SSC CGL, Bank PO, UPSC Civil Services, and various state PCS exams. See qualification-matched listings on our Graduate Jobs page.

State-Wise Sarkari Bharat Job (Bihar, UP, Tamil Nadu, and more)

State government recruitment is listed separately by state, since eligibility and domicile rules vary. Find your state's current openings via our State Government Jobs directory.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job refers to any government job opportunity across India's central and state departments - including Railways, Banking, SSC, UPSC, Defence, Police, and PSUs - offering job security, fixed pay scales, and pension benefits under government service rules.

How can I get instant Sarkari Job Alert notifications?

You can bookmark this page for daily updates, or subscribe to OnlyJobs's notification service to receive a Sarkari Job Alert as soon as a new central or state vacancy is announced.

Where can I check the latest Bharat Job Result 2026?

All declared results - including written exam results, merit lists, and interview outcomes - are listed in the Results section of this page, updated as soon as departments release official Bharat Job Result notices.

How do I find a Sarkari Job that matches my qualification?

Use the qualification filters on this page to sarkari job find openings suited to 10th pass, 12th pass, diploma, graduate, or postgraduate candidates, sorted by sector and state.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 में आवेदन कैसे करें?

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Is OnlyJobs reliable for sarkarijob updates?

Yes - OnlyJobs has tracked sarkarijob notifications since 2011, cross-verifying every listing against official department websites before publishing.

What is the difference between a Sarkari Job and a private-sector job?

Sarkari jobs offer government-backed job security, pension (NPS/OPS), fixed working hours, and statutory benefits, while private jobs typically offer market-driven pay with fewer long-term security guarantees.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

The forest department offers a range of posts across different levels, from ground-level field roles to gazetted officer positions. Most current openings on this page are for Group C posts - Forest Guard, Forester, Beat Guard, and Field Guard - making this a common landing point for anyone searching forest department group c recruitment 2026.

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols
  • Forester - supervises Forest Guards and manages a forest beat or range sub-unit
  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) - gazetted officer post, typically recruited through state forest service exams
  • Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer - recruited through UPSC, the highest field-level forestry cadre in India

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology basics)
  • Basic Mathematics / Numerical Ability
  • Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • State-specific General Knowledge (local geography, forests, wildlife sanctuaries)
  • For Ranger/RFO level: Forestry science, environmental laws, and wildlife protection acts
