Delhi High Court HJS Model Answer Key 2026 - Download Link

Delhi High Court HJS Model Answer Key 2026 has been released for the Delhi Higher Judicial Service Preliminary Examination held on 26 July 2026. Candidates can download the Series A, B, C, and D answer keys, estimate their scores, and submit online objections with valid justification until 31 July 2026 (5:00 PM). Visit the official Delhi High Court website to access the answer key PDF and objection portal.

  • Download Delhi High Court HJS Model Answer Key 2026
  • Download Delhi High Court HJS Objective Link 2026

Two conditions are specifically mentioned in the official notice:

  • Candidates are not permitted to select the same answer option that is already given in the Model Answer Key while raising an objection.
  • It is mandatory to provide justification or reasons in support of every objection filed.

Note: The official Model Answer Key PDF contains the correct option for each of the 150 questions across all four series. Because this is a scanned document released by the High Court, candidates should always cross-check their answers against the original PDF on the official website rather than relying on any third-party reproduction, to avoid transcription errors.

How to Download the Delhi HJS Model Answer Key 2026

  1. Visit the official website of the High Court of Delhi: www.delhihighcourt.nic.in
  2. Go to the "Updates" or "Public Notices > Recruitment" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the link titled "Notice for uploading of Model Answer Keys and inviting objections thereto in relation to Delhi Higher Judicial Service Preliminary Examination - 2026."
  4. The PDF will open, showing the Model Answer Keys for Series A, B, C and D.
  5. Download and save the PDF, then match it with your question paper series (mentioned on your OMR sheet/admit card).
  6. Calculate your probable score using the marking scheme given below.

How to Raise an Objection Against the Model Answer Key

  1. Visit www.delhihighcourt.nic.in and open the link "Apply online for filing objections to the Model Answer Keys in relation to Delhi Higher Judicial Service Preliminary Examination - 2026."
  2. Log in using the credentials created at the time of application/admit card download.
  3. Select the question number(s) you wish to object to, based on your question paper series.
  4. Choose an answer option other than the one already given in the Model Answer Key.
  5. Enter a valid justification or reason for each objection - this is mandatory and objections without justification may not be considered.
  6. Submit the objection before the deadline of 31 July 2026, 5:00 PM.
  7. Save or take a printout of the submission acknowledgment for future reference.

Documents Required (For Shortlisted Candidates)

Candidates declared successful in the Mains Examination must submit self-attested copies of the following documents within 5 days of the result, along with a covering letter mentioning Roll Number and Application Number:

  • Proof of age (Matriculation certificate or equivalent)
  • Xth and XIIth Class mark sheets and pass certificates
  • LL.B. degree or equivalent law degree, and all semester/consolidated mark sheets
  • Advocate's licence and Bar Council enrolment certificate
  • All India Bar Examination pass certificate (if applicable)
  • Original certificate of practice period, countersigned by the Registrar General/District Judge
  • Employer certificates (for those in service or judicial service, as applicable)
  • Copies of order sheets/judgments where the candidate appeared, for the relevant periods
  • No Objection Certificate from employer (if in government/judicial service)
  • Income Tax Return acknowledgments and Assessment Orders for the years specified in the application
  • Caste certificate (for SC/ST candidates) or Disability Certificate (for PwD candidates), where applicable

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • The application form must be filled only in English; answers in the examination are also to be given in English, except where the syllabus specifies otherwise.
  • Candidates must carry the downloaded admit card and an original, valid photo ID (Voter ID, Passport, Bar Association ID, Aadhaar, or PAN) to the exam centre. A photo ID shown only on a mobile phone is not accepted.
  • Only a blue or black ball point pen may be used to darken the OMR oval; darkening more than one oval or making any change (including with an eraser or whitener) leads to 0.25 negative marks for that question.
  • The OMR sheet cannot be carried out of the exam hall after the test.
  • Candidates already in government/judicial service, a PSU, or a bank must inform their employer that they have applied, and must submit a No Objection Certificate if selected for Viva-Voce.
  • Canvassing or use of unfair means in any form will result in disqualification.
  • PwD candidates seeking scribe and/or compensatory time facilities must submit the prescribed certificate and notarised affidavit to the Joint Registrar [Examination (Judicial)] at least 3 days before the exam date. Eligible candidates get 20 minutes of compensatory time per hour of exam duration.

Download CGPSC Assistant Librarian Model Answer Key 2026

How to Raise an Online Objection Against the Answer Key

Candidates can follow these steps to submit an objection through the CGPSC website:

  1. Visit the official CGPSC website and log in to the candidate dashboard.
  2. Go to the Activity Section and click on Objection Filing.
  3. On the new page, select the exam name, question paper, set, and the question number you want to object to.
  4. Select the applicable type of objection (see list below).
  5. Clearly write the reason for the objection in the box provided.
  6. Upload supporting proof as a PDF document (maximum size 1MB per question). Proof must include the source name, author, edition/publication date, and reference page number — mere links or website names without this detail will not be accepted.
  7. Use the Add button to submit multiple objections; unwanted entries can be removed before final submission.
  8. Click Save after entering all objections.
  9. Proceed to the fee payment page and click Pay Now to pay Rs. 50 per question for all objections raised.
  10. After successful payment, download the acknowledgement/receipt from the Dashboard under Activity Section > Download Acknowledgement.

Types of Objections Accepted

Objection Type Description
All Answer Options Incorrect All given options for a question are wrong
Commission's Answer Option Incorrect The answer option released by the commission is wrong
More Than One Correct Option More than one answer option is correct
Question is Wrong The question itself is incorrect
Question Out of Syllabus The question is not part of the prescribed syllabus
Hindi-English Translation Mismatch There is a factual difference between the Hindi and English translation of the question

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Objections can be submitted only through the online mode; no offline application or document will be accepted at the commission office.
  • Candidates get only one opportunity to submit all objections together; once the fee is paid, the process is considered complete and objections cannot be filed again.
  • Candidates are responsible for avoiding phishing, hacking, or other cyber risks during online banking/payment.
  • If the fee payment is unsuccessful, if entries are made in different sets of the same question paper, or if the prescribed process is not followed correctly, the submitted objection will be automatically rejected, and no request/appeal regarding this will be entertained by the commission.

How to Download the BPSC Assistant Environmental Scientist Final Answer Key

  1. Visit the official BPSC website: bpsc.bihar.gov.in.
  2. Open the "Advertisement" or "Notifications" section and locate Advt. No. 88/2025 - Assistant Environmental Scientist.

  4. Download the General Studies (Paper-I) key, plus the key for the optional subject (Physics, Chemistry, Life Science, or Environmental Science) you actually appeared for.
  5. Identify your question-booklet series (A, B, C, or D) printed on your OMR/admit card and match it against the correct series column in the PDF.
  6. Save a copy of the PDF for your records before calculating your probable score.

Subject-Wise Final Answer Key Summary

Every paper carries 100 questions. The table below summarizes how many questions were deleted in the final key for each subject, based on the officially released PDFs.

Subject Total Questions Questions Deleted in Final Key Reason Given in Official Key
General Studies (Paper-I) 100 1 (Q1, Series-A) Not specified in the document
Physics (Paper-II, Optional) 100 3 (Q87, Q92, Q99 - Series-A numbering) Not specified in the document
Chemistry (Paper-II, Optional) 100 1 (Q6, Series-A) Printing error in a chemical formula in the question
Life Science (Paper-II, Optional) 100 0 Not applicable
Environmental Science (Paper-II, Optional) 100 2 (Q31, Q46 - Series-A numbering) Multiple correct options / symbol not listed among options

Deleted & Reasoned Questions - Details by Subject

General Studies (Paper-I)

Question 1 in Series-A (corresponding to Q31 in Series-B, Q61 in Series-C, and Q81 in Series-D) has been marked "Deleted" in the final key. No written reason is printed against this entry in the official document; all candidates will receive marks for this question.

Physics (Paper-II, Optional)

Three questions have been deleted in the final Physics key. Using Series-A numbering, these are Q87 (Series-B: 52, Series-C: 67, Series-D: 82), Q92 (Series-B: 57, Series-C: 72, Series-D: 87), and Q99 (Series-B: 64, Series-C: 79, Series-D: 94). The official PDF does not include a reason column for this subject, so no explanation is printed against these deletions.

Chemistry (Paper-II, Optional)

Question 6 in Series-A (Series-B: 21, Series-C: 36, Series-D: 1) has been deleted. The official reason states that the question contained a printing mistake in a chemical formula, which made the question ambiguous, so it has been dropped from evaluation for all candidates.

Life Science (Paper-II, Optional)

No question has been deleted in the Life Science final key. One answer (Series-A Q82) carries an added explanatory note on food-chain trophic levels - producers, primary/secondary consumers, and decomposers - to justify the chosen correct option, but the question itself stands and has not been dropped.

Environmental Science (Paper-II, Optional)

Two questions have been deleted:

  • Series-A Q31 (Series-B: 46, Series-C: 11, Series-D: 26) - deleted because certain districts of Karnataka and Kerala have rainforest cover in addition to the option listed as fully rainforest, creating more than one correct option.
  • Series-A Q46 (Series-B: 11, Series-C: 26, Series-D: 41) - deleted because the correct answer (an animal recognized as the symbol of the World Wildlife Fund) was not present among the listed options.

Two further answers carry explanatory notes without being deleted: one clarifies that decomposers hold the largest population share in a food chain, and another confirms that pH is a logarithmic function in the mathematical sense, supporting an Assertion-Reason type question.

How to Calculate Your Probable Score

Based on the recruitment notification for this post, the written exam consists of Paper-I - General Studies (100 marks) and Paper-II - Optional Subject (300 marks), with 0.33 marks (1/3) deducted for every wrong answer. To estimate your score:

  1. Note your question-booklet series (A/B/C/D) from your admit card.
  2. Match each of your recorded responses against the correct answer in that series column of the final key.
  3. Award full marks for every correct match.
  4. Deduct 0.33 marks for every incorrect match.
  5. Treat questions marked "Deleted" as correct for all candidates, regardless of the option chosen or left unattempted.

Important Instructions

  • The released document is the final answer key, issued after review of objections raised against the provisional key (objection window: 08 July 2026 to 12 July 2026).
  • Match your answers only against the series (A/B/C/D) printed on your own question booklet - answers differ by series even though the underlying questions are the same.
  • Questions marked "Deleted" are treated as correct for every candidate and do not require any action from candidates.
  • Download the General Studies key along with only the optional subject you actually appeared for.
  • Refer to the official BPSC website for the result date and further updates, as this is not mentioned in the final answer key documents.

About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026

The ISS Examination is one of the premier competitive exams conducted by UPSC to recruit officers for Group A and Group B posts in the Indian Statistical Service. Understanding the exam structure helps candidates correctly interpret the provisional answer key.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. The exam tests candidates on subjects including Statistics, General English, and General Studies. The Statistics papers are the most technical and weightage-heavy components of the exam. The provisional answer key released covers the objective/multiple-choice components of the Statistics papers.

ISS Examination Paper Structure

The ISS Examination 2026 Statistics papers for which the provisional answer key has been released are:

  • Statistics Paper I - Covers topics such as Probability, Statistical Methods, Numerical Analysis, and related areas.
  • Statistics Paper II - Covers topics including Linear Models, Statistical Inference, Sampling Theory, and Econometrics.

How to Raise Objections Against UPSC ISS Provisional Answer Key 2026

If a candidate disagrees with any answer published in the provisional answer key, they can submit a formal representation to UPSC within the stipulated objection window period.

UPSC allows candidates to challenge answers in the provisional answer key by submitting a formal representation. The process for raising objections is as follows:

  • Download the provisional answer key PDF for the relevant paper.
  • Identify the question number(s) where you believe the answer is incorrect.
  • Prepare a written representation with supporting references from standard textbooks or study material.
  • Submit the representation to UPSC through the official channel specified in the answer key notification (typically by post or online submission to the UPSC office).
  • UPSC will review all representations received before publishing the Final Answer Key.

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026 - Download Link, Scorecard, and Marking Scheme

The Staff Selection Commission released the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026 on 17th June 2026, along with individual scorecards and response sheets for the Combined Graduate Level Examination 2025-26. Candidates who appeared in the Tier 2 exam, held on 18th and 19th January 2026, can now log in at ssc.gov.in using their Registration ID and password to download their final answer key, marks, and response sheet. The facility is available until 16th July 2026 (9:00 PM), after which the documents will no longer be accessible.

This release comes more than two months after SSC declared the Tier 2 final result on 8th April 2026, where 15,118 candidates were provisionally selected for various Group B and Group C posts. The final answer key now gives every candidate, selected or not, a way to verify exactly how their score was calculated.

Click Here: SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

What Is the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section explains what the final answer key actually is and how it differs from the result already announced earlier this year. The final answer key is the Commission's conclusively reviewed set of correct answers for every question in the Tier 2 exam, finalized after evaluating all objections submitted against the provisional key.

Unlike the provisional answer key released on 30th January 2026, this final version cannot be challenged further. It is the key against which your actual Tier 2 marks were computed, and it is now being made available alongside your scorecard so you can independently verify your result. Since the final result and merit list were already published on 8th April 2026, this release functions primarily as a transparency and verification step rather than one that changes selection outcomes.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026: Key Highlights

The table below summarizes the most important details related to this release in one place for quick reference.

Particular Detail
Exam Name Combined Graduate Level Examination 2025-26 (Tier-II)
Exam Dates 18th and 19th January 2026
Conducting Body Staff Selection Commission (SSC)
Final Answer Key Release Date 17th June 2026
Also Released On Same Date Tier 2 Scorecards and Response Sheets
Login Requires Registration ID and Password
Last Date to Download 16th July 2026 (9:00 PM)

How to Download SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section walks you through the exact login process to access your final answer key, scorecard, and response sheet from the official SSC portal.

The download process requires your individual login credentials rather than a single public link, since the answer key and scorecard are personalized to each candidate's response sheet. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Look for the notification related to the Tier 2 scorecard and final answer key for CGL 2025-26.
  3. Click on the candidate login link provided in the notification.
  4. Enter your Registration ID and Password to log in.
  5. Your scorecard, final answer key, and response sheet will be displayed on the screen.
  6. Download and save the PDF files for future reference before the access window closes.

Since this is a login-gated system tied to individual candidate records, there is no generic public download link that works for all candidates; each person must sign in with their own registered credentials.

What Information Does the Scorecard Contain

The scorecard released alongside the final answer key gives a detailed, section-wise breakdown of your performance. It typically includes your section-wise raw marks, normalized marks (since the exam was conducted across multiple shifts), your total score, and your qualifying status. Reviewing this alongside the final answer key helps you understand exactly how your final score was derived.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Marking Scheme 2026

Knowing the exact marking scheme is essential to understanding how your scorecard was calculated using the final answer key. The Tier 2 exam followed different marking rules for Paper 1 and Paper 2.

Paper Correct Answer Wrong Answer
Paper 1 (Sections I, II & Computer Module I) +3 marks -1 mark
Paper 2 (Statistics) +2 marks -0.50 marks

Unattempted questions carry zero marks under both papers, so there is no penalty for skipping a question you were unsure about. Paper 2 was applicable only to candidates who applied for Junior Statistical Officer and Statistical Investigator Grade II posts.

Timeline: From Provisional Key to Final Answer Key

This section traces the complete sequence of events from the Tier 2 exam to the release of the final answer key, helping candidates understand how each stage led to the next.

  • The Tier 2 exam was conducted on 18th and 19th January 2026.
  • The provisional answer key was released on 30th January 2026, with an objection window open until 3rd February 2026 (8:00 PM).
  • SSC reviewed all valid objections submitted against the provisional key.
  • The Tier 2 final result and merit list were declared on 8th April 2026, with 15,118 candidates provisionally selected.
  • The sliding process for post allocation was conducted between 13th and 22nd April 2026 across regional offices.
  • The final answer key, individual scorecards, and response sheets were released on 17th June 2026, accessible until 16th July 2026.

Why Check Your SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key and Scorecard

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. It allows you to verify the accuracy of your marks against the officially finalized answers, understand your section-wise and overall performance through normalized scores, and maintain a personal record for future reference, since access to these documents is time-limited. Candidates who were not selected can also use this data to identify weaker sections and plan more effectively for future SSC exam attempts.

How to Download SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026?

Downloading the SSC GD provisional answer key is a straightforward process. Follow these step-by-step instructions to access both your response sheet and the shift-wise answer key from the SSC portal.

  1. Visit the official SSC website: ssc.gov.in
  2. On the homepage, click on the "Answer Key" tab under the Latest Updates or Candidate's Corner section.

  7. Download both documents and save them as PDF files for future reference and score calculation.

SSC GD Response Sheet 2026 - What to Check

Along with the answer key, SSC has also uploaded the candidate response sheet, which contains all the answers marked by the candidate during the examination. SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026 Marking Scheme - How to Calculate Your Score

Candidates can estimate their scores using the official marking scheme prescribed by SSC. For every correct answer, 2 marks are awarded. For every incorrect answer, 0.25 marks are deducted. Unattempted questions carry zero marks.

Response Type Marks
Correct Answer +2 Marks
Incorrect Answer -0.25 Marks
Unattempted Question 0 Marks

Score Calculation Formula:
Total Score = (No. of Correct Answers × 2) − (No. of Wrong Answers × 0.25)

Out of a total of 160 marks, candidates must score the following minimum marks to qualify in the Computer Based Test:

  • Unreserved (UR) / General: 30% = 48 marks
  • OBC / EWS: 25% = 40 marks
  • SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen: 20% = 32 marks

SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026 - Objection Window

The objection window for the SSC GD Answer Key 2026 is open from 15th June 2026 (6:00 PM) to 20th June 2026 (6:00 PM). During this period, candidates who find any incorrect or disputed answer in the provisional key can formally challenge it by submitting valid supporting references and paying the prescribed fee.

Follow these steps to challenge any answer in the provisional SSC GD 2026 answer key:

  1. Go to the official SSC website: ssc.gov.in
  2. Log in using your Registration Number and Password.
  3. Click on the "Challenge Answer Key" or "Raise Objections" option.
  4. Select the specific question(s) you wish to challenge.
  5. Upload relevant supporting documents such as standard textbook references or authoritative sources to justify your objection.
  6. Pay the objection fee of ₹50 per question through the online payment gateway.
  7. Submit your challenge and download the acknowledgement receipt for your records.

SSC GD Constable Final Answer Key 2026 - What Happens Next?

After reviewing all the objections submitted by candidates, SSC release the SSC GD Final Answer Key 2026. It will contain revised answers if any changes are accepted by the Commission. The final answer key will then be used for preparing the SSC GD Result 2026. The final answer key cannot be challenged further and will be considered conclusive for result preparation. 

Candidates are advised to keep copies of both the provisional and final answer keys for future reference.

Role Snapshot
Senior Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store. Key responsibilities: A. Customer focus: 1. Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up. 2. He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers. 3. He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively. 4. He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has. B. Product recommendation: 1. With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales. 2. He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions. C. Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence: 1. Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently. 2. Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage. D. Store upkeep & maintenance: 1. He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly. 2. He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store. Note: This role requires working 6 days a week with a rotational week-off and rotational shifts based on business requirements. Please note that there are no night shifts. Training information: Candidates selected for the role after successfully completing the interview process will be attending a one-month mandatory offline training program at a designated Lenskart Academy, which is an integral part of the onboarding process.

Company Overview

Established in 2008, Zicasso is the most-reviewed and highest-rated luxury travel company, specializing in immersive custom tours, vacations, and safaris. Our Zicasso travel specialists are the worldâs top 2% of boutique tour operators and travel agents, pre-vetted and handpicked to compete in creating itineraries tailored to each of our travelersâ unique preferences. Joining Zicasso, you'll play a key role in bringing our travelersâ dreams to lifeâpushing the boundaries of whatâs possible with luxury travel experiences.

As a member of our team, youâll be part of a company recognized for its strong brand reputation among discerning travelers. Our authority in the luxury travel industry is consistently affirmed through features in top media outlets, including The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, BBC, Forbes, CNN, and CondÃ© Nast Traveler, to name a few. See our press coverage here.

We are a fully remote company spanning five continents, and we foster a dynamic, progressive global work environment that values creativity, initiative, and continuous learning. We're seeking passionate, data-driven individuals who thrive in a high-performance environment and are eager to contribute to our innovative company culture, underpinned by a consistent pursuit of excellence, integrity, and teamwork.

Our global team comes together biannually for international retreats and summits. These are typically held for a week at a new location each time, providing opportunities to share ideas, collaborate in person, and strengthen our culture, all while learning firsthand about the destinations we serve. These events embody our commitment to both professional growth and the transformative power of travel.

Join us in shaping the future of luxury travel while working towards our visionâcreating a more connected humanity through travel. To learn more, visit https://www.zicasso.com/careers.


The Role

Currently, we are seeking a highly motivated, customer service-minded Traveler Care Specialist who embraces an entrepreneurial spirit and has a passion for international travel!

This role will be working at the intersection of our travelers and Zicassoâs global network of travel providers (partners), making both sides delighted with Zicassoâs unique matching service and will be responsible for assessing and processing incoming travel inquiries via email/messaging, phone, and online. You will learn to understand analytics and help ensure that we are maximizing the potential of our leads. You will build trusted relationships with our travelers to understand their travel needs and ensure these needs are being met and their expectations exceeded. This position plays a key role towards driving loyalty and repeat bookings of our most valued travelers.

This is an international, fully remote, freelance contractor position, working from home with a 5-day workweek that includes rotating weekend shifts. Initial training (3 to 4 weeks) will take place Monday through Friday.Â 

This role is open to candidates located outside of the United States, with a strong preference for those based in Argentina, Costa Rica, Brazil, and Colombia.

The work will all be conducted in English.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide exceptional customer service to travelers by taking ownership of their inquiries and becoming a trusted advisor throughout their use of Zicasso services. This includes assessing and solving incoming traveler inquiries via phone, live chat, messages and email.
  • Build trusted, long-lasting relationships with discerning luxury clients to strengthen their confidence in Zicasso. This involves assisting and serving clients in a way that meets their needs and exceeds their expectations.
  • Ensure a high level of inquiry conversion by demonstrating expertise in consultation, product knowledge, and the benefits of using Zicasso. This includes speaking with travelers via phone calls (and sometimes video), helping them understand how Zicasso works, and providing guidance for their travel needs.
  • Participate cross-functionally with the Partnerships, Product, and Marketing teams to integrate best practices and solutions for the client's experience and/or issues that may arise.
  • Partner with the Care Team leadership on projects and initiatives to solve problems and create innovative solutions.
  • Leverage Zicassoâs data, analytics and technologyÂ  to set new standards for customer success, driving innovation and excellence for the luxury travel industry.
  • Provide consultation and advice to move general inquiries to destination-specific trip requests.
  • Coach and mentor team members as needed.

Please Note: Weâre seeking highly-motivated candidates. Those who excel in this role will be given the opportunity to take on increasingly complex projects and initiatives, and grow their role and responsibility within the Traveler Care Team.


Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in the travel industry, with a focus on travel sales or operations of luxury tours or hotels. Examples of relevant experience include tour leader, tour director, hotel front desk, client relations, or guest services
  • Passionate about travel, with extensive experience traveling abroad and a strong curiosity about new international destinations.
  • Strong customer service-focused skills, with a passion for building strong relationships with travelers. This includes being comfortable with telephone-based work as a key part of the role.
  • Excellent fluency in oral and written English.
  • A cheerful and confident person who is adaptable to different styles of communication and traveler behaviors.
  • Highly motivated and enthusiastic, with a willingness to put in extra effort in a start-up environment to drive company success.
  • Comfortable with technology and able to quickly learn and adapt to the use of new software. Thorough knowledge of Google Workspace (formerly G Suite) (e.g. Docs, Sheets, Slides) is preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, striving to achieve quality, error-free work.
  • Work flexible hours, including weekends, evenings, and holidays.
  • A Bachelor's degree or higher is preferred.


What We Offer:

  • Remote work from your home base and flexible hours that allow you to enjoy a great work-life balance.
  • Innovative, fast-paced and collaborative culture that values diverse voices and opinions.
  • Learning and development annual stipend.
  • Enjoy two company-sponsored business trips each year at international destinations we serve!

If you are a customer service-minded problem solver with a passion for travel and a strong desire to make a difference, we strongly encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to join our team and help shape the future of personalized, life-enriching travel experiences at Zicasso!

All applications should be submitted in English.

Applicable to all locations, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities; if you need an accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact careers@zicasso.com.

About the role
 As a Project Administrator, you will serve as a central point of coordination for the team, handling the logistical and administrative tasks that keep our projects moving forward. You will work closely with project leads to track progress, update documentation, and facilitate clear communication across different workstreams. This is an entry level position designed for someone who is highly organized and wants to start a career in project management within a professional investment firm. The role is fully remote, requiring a professional who can manage their tasks independently while staying connected with a distributed team.

What you will do
  • Maintain and update project schedules to ensure all milestones are recorded and visible to the team.
  • Organize and manage digital files and documentation related to the Spanish telecommunications engagement.
  • Prepare regular status reports that summarize project progress for internal reviews and meetings.
  • Coordinate internal meetings and ensure that all participants have the necessary materials and agendas beforehand.
  • Track project expenses and administrative tasks to assist with budget oversight and record keeping.
  • Assist with the drafting of internal updates to keep all team members informed of project developments.
  • Monitor project timelines to identify any potential delays early in the process and report them to leads.
  • Update internal databases and project management tools to reflect the most current information.


What we are looking for
  • A background in business administration, management, or a related field of study.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple administrative tasks simultaneously.
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Basic familiarity with standard project management tools and documentation software.
  • A methodical approach to work with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
  • The ability to work effectively and independently in a fully remote environment.
  • A reliable and professional attitude toward meeting deadlines and following internal instructions.
  • Proficiency in standard office applications for documentation, data entry, and scheduling.


What we offer
  • A permanent, full-time position within a stable and respected investment firm.
  • A fully remote working arrangement that supports professional autonomy and focus.
  • Competitive pay that reflects the responsibilities of the role and the current market.
  • Opportunities for professional development and learning within the project management field.
  • A professional home where your contributions to project efficiency are recognized.
  • Access to modern tools and systems that support reliable remote collaboration.
  • A calm and focused working environment free from the distractions of a traditional office.
  • The chance to work on large scale projects with significant international partners.


Working at Bavarian Capital
 Bavarian Capital is built on a foundation of reliability and long term thinking. We avoid the frantic pace often found in the investment sector, preferring instead to move with purpose and precision. This approach extends to how we manage our team, offering a high degree of professional autonomy and a clear, remote first structure. We believe that by providing a stable and respectful environment, our team members can focus on their craft and produce their best work. This role is a chance to start a career in an organization that values clarity, thoughtful decision making, and the sustainable growth of its people and its projects. We prioritize steady progress over short term trends, ensuring that every member of our team has a reliable and predictable path forward.

Job Description

As a Ship-to-Shore Technician, you will play a vital role in supporting the safe and efficient operation of vessels arriving and departing at the port. This position involves working on the dock to ensure the proper mooring, securing, and release of ships, while maintaining safety and operational standards. In addition to mooring responsibilities, the role will also involve performing general maintenance and support tasks as required to ensure overall port and equipment readiness.

The Ship-to-Shore Technician is responsible for, but not limited to the following:

Docking and Undocking Operations

  • Assist in safely docking and undocking cruise ships at port using mooring lines, ropes, and related equipment.
  • Work in coordination with the shipâs captain, crew, and port authorities to ensure that vessels are safely secured and aligned with docking infrastructure.

Mooring Line Management:

  • Handle and manage mooring lines, ensuring they are properly fastened, tense, and released.
  • Perform visual inspection of mooring lines and related equipment regularly for wear and damage, ensuring everything is in safe working condition. (Regularly performed by ship crew)

Ship and Dock Safety

  • Maintain safety protocols during mooring procedures, ensuring that all tasks are performed in accordance with safety regulations.
  • Monitor weather conditions and report any changes that could affect docking or undocking procedures.

Communication and Coordination

  • Communicate effectively with other team members on board and shore-based personnel.
  • Work with the Port Authorities to ensure the timely and safe transfer of passengers and cargo.

Emergency Procedures

  • Be trained to respond in case of an emergency during docking or undocking operations, including accidents or hazardous situations.
  • Ensure all mooring operations are conducted efficiently and safely, even under adverse weather conditions or emergencies.

PPE Equipment (MANDATORY)

  • Must always be in possession of steel toe boots (or prescribed non-slip safety shoes), safety vest, hard hat, gloves, radio/communication device. (To be provided by Carnival)

Cleaning & Maintenance of Pier & Mooring Equipment & Fixtures:

  • Ensure all mooring equipment such as winches, ropes, and fenders are properly maintained and operational (through visual checks and inspections).
  • Gangway Inspections & Maintenance: Inspect gangway components for wear, corrosion, proper tension, secure connections, and smooth operation to ensure safe pedestrian access and functionality.
  • Fenders: Conduct visual inspections of pier fenders and associated hardware to identify cracks, deformation, excessive wear, or damage caused by vessel contact, and report deficiencies as needed.
  • Mooring Bollards: Regularly inspect mooring bollards for structural integrity, including corrosion, cracks, loose anchor bolts, foundation stress, and coating condition, to ensure safe vessel mooring.
  • Stanchions & Pier Fixtures: Inspect stanchions and associated components for corrosion, damage, misalignment, or instability, ensuring they remain secure and serviceable.
  • Ropes: Inspect ropes for wear, fraying, or damage, and verify they are properly positioned and suitable for continued use.
  • Mooring Equipment Maintenance: Perform minor maintenance and repairs of mooring equipment when necessary.
  • Pier & Dock Cleaning: Maintain clean, safe, and non-slip pier surfaces by removing dirt, salt, algae, stains, debris and other buildup by pressure washing and using prescribed cleaning equipment and solutions, along all designated cruise pier and trestle areas.
  • Cleaning Equipment Operation: Safely inspect, operate, and maintain cleaning equipment, including scrubbers and pressure washers, ensuring proper use, cleaning, and storage after each operation.

Additional Maintenance Support Activities

  • Perform minor maintenance support to technical teams including plumbing, electrical, masonry, carpentry, and HVAC functions.

Mandatory Training:

  • Maintain compliance with organizational requirements by attending and participating in all required company training sessions.

Lagoon Care

  • Perform maintenance/inspections of lagoon systems.

Education:

  • Education: High School Diploma.
  • Maintenance knowledge is preferred.
  • Certified Pool Operator (CPO) required within 6 months of employment start.
  • Three to Five years' experience working in a mooring or associated fields.

Essential Experience Required:

Must be physically fit. Must have strong customer service skills. Ability to work in an outdoor environment. Ability to multi-task and think critically. Previous work experience preferred. Prolonged periods standing and working outside. Must be able to lift, up to 50 pounds at times. All island employees must be physically able to participate in emergency lifesaving procedures and drills. Full use/range of motion of arms and legs as well as full visual, verbal and hearing abilities are required to receive and give instructions in the event of an emergency. Ability to read and write English to understand and interpret written procedures. This includes the ability to give and receive instructions in written and verbal forms and to effectively present information and respond to questions from guests, managers, and co-workers.

Role Snapshot

About the LSPA: The LSP Association (LSPA) is a non-profit association for Massachusetts Licensed Site Professionals (LSPs) and other related environmental practitioners who work on behalf of property owners, operators, and other involved parties to assess and cleanup oil and hazardous materials (OHM) released to the environment. LSPs are licensed by the Commonwealth to oversee this work and, since 1993, over 40,000 contaminated properties have been brought into regulatory compliance.


The LSPA's mission is to support our membership in achieving and maintaining a high standard of practice in the assessment and remediation of contaminated sites in Massachusetts and New England. The LSPA provides technical and educational resources to our membership in the form of programming, networking events, committees, and resources. The LSPA also serves as an advocate to the profession with MassDEP, the LSP Board of Registration, and the state legislature, and as a resource to the public.


Job Description: The Program & Events Coordinator plays a critical role in the success of the LSPA and serves as a primary point of contact for our members, volunteers, and sponsors. This individual is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the association's educational programs and networking events, administering the sponsorship program, and providing customer service support. Success in this position means delivering high-quality member experiences, maintaining strong relationships with volunteers and sponsors, and ensuring the smooth administration of our continuing education program.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-focused, and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously. This individual enjoys working independently while collaborating closely with volunteers, board members, speakers, sponsors, and staff.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Educational Programs: Coordinate, plan, and manage programs and speakers for all LSPA courses, membership meetings, emerging professional events, the Annual Fall Party, and the Environmental Symposium. The LSPA hosts one to three events per month with 25-250 people in attendance. Approximately 65% of programming is hosted virtually. Content creation is performed in conjunction with input from the Executive Director, Committee Chairs, Education Committee, and Board of Directors.
  • Event Logistics: For in-person events, source event venues and help facilitate contracts; plan food and beverage, room set-up, and audiovisual needs; reconcile venue bills; and serve as the point of contact on-site. For virtual programs, setup and run the virtual meeting platform, monitor attendance and engagement, create moderator scripts and slides, and train speakers on how to use the virtual platform.
  • Continuing Education (CE) Administration: Compile CE materials for all educational courses and meetings; submit materials for credit approval with the LSP Board of Registration, the Connecticut Licensed Environmental Professional (LEP) Board, and other Boards/entities; maintain CE records related to attendance, engagement, and evaluation; issue certificates of attendance to attendees; and attend monthly virtual LSP Board of Registration meetings.
  • Sponsorship: Help administer the corporate and event sponsorship program, including updating the sponsorship prospectus, facilitating invoices/payments, maintaining contact lists, conducting outreach, and working with sponsors to access their sponsorship benefits.
  • Member Service and Organizational Support: Help monitor and respond to inquiries received through the organization email inbox; provide customer service to members, sponsors, speakers, and event attendees; attend Board meetings, leadership meetings, and committee meetings as requested; and support association operations and special projects as needed.


Qualifications

The person hired for this role should have the following qualifications:


Experience:

  • 2-5 years of experience in program/event planning, project management, or another related field.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and proven ability to provide excellent customer service.
  • Strong project management skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines independently.
  • Comfortable coordinating, building relationships with, and communicating professionally with members, volunteers, sponsors, vendors, and other external stakeholders/partners.


Technology:

  • Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Zoom Meetings and Zoom Webinar, including coordinating presenters from multiple locations, incorporating polling, and managing technical issues.
  • Association management systems (AMS) or member databases.
  • Online registration and evaluation platforms.
  • Canva or similar design tools (preferred, not required).

Preferred Qualifications (not required):

  • Experience working for a nonprofit organization, professional association, or membership-based organization.
  • Experience with the environmental sciences industry.
  • Familiarity with sponsorship development or relationship management.
  • Bachelor's degree, Associate's degree with relevant experience, or significant relevant professional experience demonstrating the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the position successfully.

Why Join the LSPA?

This is an opportunity to work with a respected association that supports environmental professionals making a meaningful impact on public health and environmental protection throughout Massachusetts and New England. As a small organization, we offer autonomy, flexibility, and the opportunity to build relationships with industry leaders while helping shape the educational and professional development experiences of our members. Compensation and benefits include:

  • Salary: The salary range for this position is $70,000â$80,000 annually. Compensation will be based on a variety of factors such as individual qualifications and experience.
  • Benefits: LSPA employees receive $300 per month for a Healthcare Reimbursement Account (HRA) that may be used to reimburse certain medical and insurance-related expenses. The organization does not currently offer group health or dental insurance plans. In addition, employees have access to a 401(k) plan.
  • PTO: 15 days of paid time off (PTO) annually for the first three years (increases to 20 days thereafter). The LSPA also provides 14 holidays per year (inclusive of 5 floating holidays).
  • Fully remote position: Candidates may reside anywhere in New England, with preference given to Massachusetts-based applicants. Travel to Massachusetts-based programs and events approximately 10â12 times annually is required.
  • Reimbursement for home office expenses: $750 annually.


How to Apply

Please submit a cover letter and resume to mmorris@lspa.org. Applications without cover letters or that request compensation/benefits beyond what we can provide will not be reviewed.


The LSPA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, contact mmorris@lspa.org.


The LSPA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.
